summary: Queen of All Saints Academy emphasizes the importance of E-Rate funding for maintaining reliable internet connectivity and affordability for their educational program. They urge the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding to avoid financial burdens on schools and families.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, school would face substantial increase in monthly internet expenses
claims.evidence_quote: Without the 80% discount, our school would have to pay a substantial increase in monthly internet expenses as well as the cost of maintaining and replacing essential network infrastructure.
